verdict.en: Only useful during the Locked Gate event: hand it in at the control room, never extract with it.
verdict.zh: 仅在“上锁的大门”事件中有用：送到控制室，别带出局。

use.en: One of four codes that open the main gate on The Blue Gate during Locked Gate. Take it to the Gate Control Room and put it in one of the four terminals; it is removed on submission. Extract with it and it turns into an Expired Security Code, which is worthless, and the gate may then never open for the lobby.
use.zh: 它是“上锁的大门”事件中打开蓝门主闸门所需的四枚安全码之一。带到蓝门控制室，插入四个终端之一，提交后即被消耗。若带着它撤离，会变成过期安全码，毫无用处，还可能让整局的大门打不开。

obtain.en: Search any lootable container in the Ancient Fort. At least one code spawns per round, sometimes more. The other three codes come from Raider's Refuge, Pilgrim's Peak and Reinforced Reception.
obtain.zh: 在古代要塞搜任意可搜刮容器即可，每局至少刷出一枚，有时更多。另外三枚分别在奇袭者避难所、朝圣峰和加固前台。

tips.en: It sells for next to nothing, so the only reason to carry it is to submit it. Don't pocket it for a later raid.
tips.zh: 它几乎不值钱，带着只为提交。别留到下一局，它是临时物品。

tips.en: A teammate can find the same code, so you don't need to be the one who reaches the control room.
tips.zh: 同一枚码队友也能找到，不一定非得你自己送到控制室。

verdict.en: A cheap, low-risk key for cellar stashes: use it if you pass the spot, don't plan a raid around it.
verdict.zh: 地窖钥匙便宜又低风险：路过就开，不值得专门跑一趟。

use.en: It opens several cellar doors on The Blue Gate, not one fixed room. Reports name a cellar at Trapper's Glade and another left of Ruined Homestead; the second is said to hold weapons, blueprints, grenades and healing items. Treat it as a small bonus stash.
use.zh: 它能打开蓝门的多个地窖门，而不是某个固定房间。有攻略提到猎人林地的地窖和废弃农庄左侧的地窖，后者可能出武器、蓝图、手雷和治疗物品。当作小型额外藏点即可。

obtain.en: Random drop while scavenging; the wiki places one west of Olive Grove. A hatch entrance south of Olive Grove and Ruined Homestead is one reliable way in.
obtain.zh: 搜刮时随机获得，社区维基标注其中一处在橄榄树林以西。橄榄树林和废弃农庄以南有一处舱口入口，比较好找。

tips.en: It sells for only 100 and nothing in the workshop needs it, so using it costs you nothing.
tips.zh: 只值100钱币，工坊也不需要，用掉不亏。

verdict.en: A middling key: the basement room is quiet, but loot is mostly electrical items.
verdict.zh: 中等偏下：地下室相对安静，但多是电子类物资。

use.en: The door is a locked metal door in the basement of Pilgrim's Peak, by the Communication Tower in the far north of The Blue Gate. The room has server racks, a weapon box, drawers and resource crates. One guide says it is mostly electrical items, so rate it a situational stop.
use.zh: 门在蓝门最北侧、通讯塔旁的朝圣峰地下室，是一扇金属门。房间里有服务器机架、武器箱、抽屉和资源箱。有攻略称主要出电子类物品，属于顺路再开的点。

obtain.en: The quest Groundbreaking gives one. Otherwise it is a random drop from containers in residential and commercial buildings, and no quest guarantees more.
obtain.zh: 完成任务“突破性进展”可获得一把；其余只能靠居民区和商业区容器随机掉落。

tips.en: If you will do Groundbreaking anyway, keep the first key for it before sparing later ones.
tips.zh: 打算做“突破性进展”的话，先留一把给任务，多出来的再用或卖。

tips.en: A zipline runs down to the tower area, so the approach is easier from above.
tips.zh: 通讯塔有索道可以从高处下来，进入更方便。

verdict.en: The best Blue Gate key to open, but the room is contested, so go in ready for a fight.
verdict.zh: 蓝门最值得开的钥匙，但这间房很抢手，要做好交火准备。

use.en: The door is in the underground tunnels, in the confiscated goods area under the Security Wing. Guides call it one of the map's best loot rooms and one of the keys most worth using, but also very risky because other raiders target it. Bring a shield and clear the approach before you open it.
use.zh: 门在蓝门地下隧道的没收物库房，位于安保区辅楼下方。攻略普遍称它是全图最好的战利品房之一、最值得用的钥匙之一，但也很危险，常有人蹲守。带好护盾，开门前先清场。

obtain.en: Scavenging only. The wiki puts one on the ground floor of the Security Wing, next to the Traffic Tunnel below the Headhouse. Containers near Ruby Residence are also named.
obtain.zh: 只能搜刮获得。社区维基称在安保区辅楼一层、候车室下方通行隧道旁有刷新点；红宝石宅邸附近的容器也有人提到。

tips.en: Players often zipline down from Reinforced Reception to reach the tunnels; the vertical shaft and Communication Tower are other routes.
tips.zh: 常见路线是从加固前台沿索道下去，也可走竖井或通讯塔。

tips.en: Epic rarity but only 100 coins to a trader, so selling it is a waste.
tips.zh: 稀有度为史诗，商人只给100钱币，卖掉太亏。

verdict.en: A safe, modest key: one old village house with decent but unremarkable loot.
verdict.zh: 安全但收益一般：只开一栋旧村屋，战利品中规中矩。

use.en: It opens a locked building in the Village on the west side of The Blue Gate. Guides split on the reward: one calls the loot usually modest and the safer option, another a high-tier area. Expect ordinary containers rather than a jackpot.
use.zh: 它打开蓝门西侧村庄里的一栋上锁建筑。各家评价不一：一份攻略说收益通常一般、胜在安全，另一份称是高档区域。预期是普通容器，不是大奖。

obtain.en: Random drop from containers in residential areas; no quest hands one out, so it can take several raids to see one.
obtain.zh: 居民区容器随机掉落，没有任务发放，可能要跑几局才见到。

tips.en: You can only get 100 coins for it, so open the house if you walk past and skip it if the village is busy.
tips.zh: 卖也只有100钱币，路过就开；村庄人多就别硬进。

verdict.en: Worth opening when you already hold it, not worth a raid spent hunting for it.
verdict.zh: 手上有就值得开，不值得专门去找。

use.en: The door is in the north-west corner of the Hospital second floor (one guide counts it as the third). From the Northern Metro entrance, climb the stairs, turn left through the long hall to the locker room, leave by the far door and turn right. Expect roughly ten containers: weapons, blueprints, consumables and valuables.
use.zh: 门在医院二楼西北角（有攻略算作三楼）。从北侧地铁站入口上楼左转，穿过长走廊到储物柜房间，从对面门出去后立刻右转。里面约有十个可搜刮点，可能出武器、蓝图、消耗品和贵重物品。

obtain.en: Random drop from cabinets, drawers and desks in Buried City buildings; a raider who dies carrying one also drops it.
obtain.zh: 掩埋废城建筑里的柜子、抽屉和书桌随机掉落；带钥匙死亡的玩家也会掉出。

tips.en: A documented run found a Dam Control Tower Key in this room, which chains into another vault.
tips.zh: 曾有人在这间房里开出大坝控制塔钥匙，可以接着开下一个房间。

tips.en: Keep it in a Safe Pocket so a death doesn't cost it; leave via the Northern Metro entrance for a quiet exit.
tips.zh: 放进安全口袋防止死亡丢失；从北侧地铁站撤离比较隐蔽。

verdict.en: A solid mid-tier key: one fourth-floor room with weapons, mods and rare materials.
verdict.zh: 中档好钥匙：四楼一间房，可能出武器、配件和稀有材料。

use.en: It opens a locked room on the fourth floor, north side, of the J Kozma Ventures building, called the Space Travel on the map. Gameriv lists it among the keys most worth using, with weapons, weapon mods and rare materials possible. It is a single room, so loot is limited.
use.zh: 它打开J·科兹马创投公司大楼（地图上称航天大楼）四楼北侧的一间上锁房间。有攻略把它列入最值得用的钥匙，可能出武器、武器配件和稀有材料。只有一间房，总量有限。

obtain.en: Scavenging only, mainly from residential containers. No quest gives it.
obtain.zh: 只能搜刮，多来自居民区容器，没有任务奖励。

tips.en: Fourth-floor rooms leave few escape routes, so check the stairwell before you commit.
tips.zh: 四楼退路少，进房前先确认楼梯间安全。

verdict.en: Opens a few apartment doors; handy if you are already in the apartments, otherwise skip.
verdict.zh: 能开几扇公寓门，人在公寓区时顺手用，否则不必专程。

use.en: It opens several locked apartment doors in Buried City, so it is not tied to one room. Sources place one in the northern Grandioso Apartments (described as useful loot), one near Plaza Rosa by Main Street, and another south of West Village. Details are thin, and reports disagree on how good the loot is.
use.zh: 它能开掩埋废城的多扇公寓门，不对应单一房间。资料中提到北部奢华公寓（战利品还不错）、玫瑰广场附近的主街，以及西村以南的楼。信息很少，对收益的评价也不一。

obtain.en: Scavenging only; drawers and shelves in residential buildings are the usual places.
obtain.zh: 只能搜刮，居民楼的抽屉和架子是常见来源。

tips.en: It is Uncommon and sells for 100, so using it costs little.
tips.zh: 稀有度只有优秀，卖也只有100钱币，用了不心疼。

verdict.en: The best key in Buried City: it opens the Town Hall, a loot room worth fighting for.
verdict.zh: 掩埋废城最值得的钥匙：市政厅的战利品房值得为它拼一把。

use.en: The door is on the north side of the Town Hall, at ground level, and the room holds two Security Lockers and a Weapon Case. Guides call it one of the best key uses in the game, though a player post claims big credit hauls plus blueprints. Expect company, so loot fast and plan your exit.
use.zh: 门在市政厅北侧一层，房内有两个保安储物柜和一个武器箱。攻略称它是全游戏最值得的钥匙之一，玩家帖子称一趟能赚不少钱币，还可能出蓝图。多半有人来抢，速战速决并提前想好撤离路线。

obtain.en: The quest Our Presence up There gives one. Otherwise random drops, with Security Lockers and Weapon Cases listed on the wiki; Grandioso Apartments containers are named too.
obtain.zh: 完成任务“我们在上面的据点”送一把；其余随机掉落，社区维基列出保安储物柜和武器箱，也有人提到奢华公寓的容器。

tips.en: Set mines or a barrier at the door before opening; rushing the lock is how people die.
tips.zh: 开门前先在门口布地雷或设障，莽开最容易送命。

tips.en: Don't sell it for 100 coins, and put it in a Safe Pocket.
tips.zh: 别卖100钱币，放进安全口袋带着。

verdict.en: Opens the top of the Control Tower: strong loot on paper, but the tower is dangerous and opinions are split.
verdict.zh: 开控制塔顶部：纸面战利品强，但很危险，评价两极。

use.en: The door is on the top floor of the Control Tower on Dam Battlegrounds. Lockers, medical bags, weapon cases and ammo cases can spawn inside. One guide ranks the loot among the map's strongest but very dangerous, another says low priority, so treat it as a gamble.
use.zh: 门在大坝战场控制塔顶层，房内可能刷出储物柜、医疗包、武器箱和弹药箱。一份攻略把战利品列为全图前列、但极其危险，另一份认为优先级低，算是一场赌博。

obtain.en: The quest The Trifecta gives one. Otherwise it drops from containers in admin and residential buildings; the Buried City Hospital room has also dropped one.
obtain.zh: 完成任务“三连胜”送一把；其余在行政楼和居民楼的容器里随机掉落，掩埋废城医院的房间也曾开出过。

tips.en: Keep one for The Trifecta before spending others.
tips.zh: 先留一把给“三连胜”，再考虑其他用途。

tips.en: At 100 coins it is a poor sale, so take the gamble only if you can hold the tower.
tips.zh: 卖只有100钱币，不划算；有把握守住控制塔再去赌。

verdict.en: Opens a side room in the Controlled Access Zone; worth using once you are in the zone, but its loot is reported by one guide only.
verdict.zh: 开受控访问区里的一间侧室；人到区里就值得用，但房内物资只有一份攻略提到。

use.en: It opens a plain locked door (no yellow puzzle panel) in the Controlled Access Zone, next to Generator Hall and the Power Generation Complex. TroubleChute's map puts it on level B2, reached by a staircase from below or a ladder from above; one guide says it sits off the corridor on the side with the broken stairway, away from the central puzzle room. That guide reports med supplies, a gun or two, grenades and components.
use.zh: 它打开受控访问区里一扇普通锁门（没有黄色谜题面板），该区在发电机大厅和发电厂综合体旁。社区互动地图标在B2层，可从下方楼梯或上方梯子过去；一份攻略说门在断楼梯那一侧的走廊边，远离中央谜题房。该攻略称房内有医疗品、一两把枪、手雷和零件。

obtain.en: Random container drop, added in 1.17; no reliable spawn spot is documented.
obtain.zh: 1.17加入的随机容器掉落，没有可靠的刷新点记录。

tips.en: The key room is separate from the vault: the vault needs the button puzzle plus a material payment that changes each raid (Batteries, Leaper Pulse Units and Metal Parts have been reported).
tips.zh: 钥匙房和金库是两回事：金库要解按钮谜题，再交一份每局不同的材料（有报告要过电池、“跳跃者”脉冲单元和金属零件）。

tips.en: The zone's 22 container spots roll Mechanical and ARC loot, so a run there pays even without the key.
tips.zh: 该区约22个容器点出机械类和ARC类物资，没钥匙也值得跑。

verdict.en: Decent loot, but the building is crowded; fine for The Stench of Corruption, optional otherwise.
verdict.zh: 战利品尚可但人多；做“腐败的恶臭”时需要，其余看心情。

use.en: The door is on the first floor of the Research & Administration building. From the west entrance it is almost straight ahead; from the south entrance it is on your right. Several red lockers can drop high-rarity gear. Guides split between decent and not worth the risk. Close the door behind you.
use.zh: 门在研究与行政区大楼一层。从西入口进几乎正对面，从南入口进则在右手边。房内有数个红色储物柜，可能出高稀有度装备。攻略评价不一，有说不错的，也有说不值得冒险的。进房后记得关门。

obtain.en: The quest The Stench of Corruption gives one. Otherwise random drops from containers, especially in the Research & Administration itself.
obtain.zh: 完成任务“腐败的恶臭”送一把；其余在容器中随机掉落，尤其是研究与行政区本身。

tips.en: Raiders rush in when they hear the door unlock, so open it only after clearing the hall.
tips.zh: 开锁声会引来其他人，先清场再开门。

verdict.en: A quick, safe-ish early key: standard loot in a small room, and a quest needs two.
verdict.zh: 早期快速又相对安全的钥匙：小房间普通战利品，任务要两把。

use.en: The door is on the first floor, south side, of the Water Treatment Control buildings on Dam Battlegrounds. Guides call the loot standard but inconsistent, good for quick scavenging runs, especially early in the game. It won't change your economy.
use.zh: 门在大坝战场水处理控制中心建筑一层南侧。攻略称战利品普通且不稳定，适合快速搜刮，尤其是前期。不会改变你的经济。

obtain.en: The quest Greasing Her Palms gives two. Otherwise random drops in Ruby Residence and Research & Administration containers.
obtain.zh: 完成任务“打通通路”送两把；其余在红宝石宅邸和研究与行政区的容器里随机掉落。

tips.en: Hold what Greasing Her Palms asks for before opening any on your own.
tips.zh: 先留够“打通通路”要的数量，再用多余的。

verdict.en: Worth a quick stop if you're nearby, but one key opens only one of the two doors.
verdict.zh: 就在附近时值得顺路开，但一把钥匙只能开两扇门中的一扇。

use.en: The Testing Annex has two locked doors on the ground floor, one on the south side and one on the east. One key opens one door, so you need two for both. Guides call the loot mid-tier, sometimes rated lower-end.
use.zh: 测试附楼一层有两扇上锁的门，一扇在南侧，一扇在东侧。一把钥匙只能开其中一扇，两扇都开需要两把。攻略评价为中档战利品，有时被排在偏下。

obtain.en: The quest A Lay of the Land gives one. Otherwise lockers, drawers and filing cabinets in admin buildings.
obtain.zh: 完成任务“地形勘查”送一把；其余在行政楼的储物柜、抽屉和文件柜里随机掉落。

tips.en: If you carry only one, pick the door that is easier to reach and ignore the other.
tips.zh: 只有一把时选更好到达的那扇门，别纠结另一扇。

verdict.en: A one-use pass into the Fallen Emperor at Pendola Pass, which guides call the map's best loot spot.
verdict.zh: 进入彭多拉山口“陨落帝王”的一次性通行证，攻略称是该图最好的战利品点。

use.en: Take it to the entrance at the base of the Fallen Emperor on Pendola Pass and use it there. Guides say the interior holds rare blueprints and loot pods that can drop the Emperor Modulator. One guide notes the interior was locked early on, so some details are unconfirmed.
use.zh: 带到彭多拉山口陨落帝王底部的入口使用。攻略称内部有稀有蓝图，战利品舱可能掉落“帝王”调制器。有攻略提到内部早期上锁，部分细节尚未证实。

obtain.en: Craft it at the Workbench once you learn its blueprint, using the three couplers. Blueprint and couplers drop from Harvester payloads and Bully ARC during Redirection. Alternatively it is the last reward of the Frozen Trail Reward Pass.
obtain.zh: 学会蓝图后在工作台制作，需要三种耦合器。蓝图和耦合器出自“航向重定向”事件中的收割者空投和恶霸ARC；也可作为霜痕小径奖励通行证的最后一项奖励。

tips.en: Blueprint chances are low, so expect several Redirection raids. Don't sell it for 1000.
tips.zh: 蓝图掉率低，要做好跑多局“航向重定向”的准备；别卖那1000钱币。

tips.en: Reward Pass level 60 is the guaranteed route if you play the pass anyway.
tips.zh: 如果本来就在刷通行证，60级是最稳的方式。

verdict.en: Pure junk: a spent Locked Gate code that opens nothing. Sell it for 10 coins.
verdict.zh: 纯废品：用过的上锁大门安全码，什么也打不开，卖掉换10钱币。

obtain.en: You don't find it. Bringing a used Locked Gate security key to Speranza turns it into this item, so it only shows up if you hoard old codes.
obtain.zh: 无法在局内捡到。把用过的上锁大门安全码交给斯佩兰扎就会变成它，所以只有囤旧码时才会出现。

tips.en: Nothing in the workshop or quests asks for it, so free the inventory slot (it doesn't stack).
tips.zh: 工作台和任务都不需要它，而且不能堆叠，直接清掉省格子。

verdict.en: Don't plan around it: current guides open the Spaceport bunker with antennas, not a key, so treat this as a 100-coin sale item.
verdict.zh: 别指望它：现有攻略里太空港地堡靠天线开启而非钥匙，当作100钱币的卖品即可。

use.en: The item says it opens a bunker on The Spaceport. Every guide I found describes the Hidden Bunker map condition instead: you activate four antennas, then the entrances just west of the Departure Building open for the whole lobby. Inside are eight data terminals worth 500 XP each, but no guide lists a loot table, and the key's own door is unconfirmed.
use.zh: 物品说明称它能打开太空港的一处地堡。但我查到的攻略都说隐藏地堡是地图条件：激活四座天线后，候机楼西侧的入口对全场开放；里面有8个数据终端，每个给500经验。没有攻略列出具体战利品，这把钥匙对应的门也无法证实。

obtain.en: No source says where it drops; a search a week into 2.0 still found no guide that mentions the item, and the community wiki has no page for it. The bunker is only available while the Hidden Bunker condition is active, and raids last 40 minutes then.
obtain.zh: 没有资料说明掉落处；2.0上线一周后再查，仍没有攻略提到这件物品，社区维基也没有它的页面。地堡只在“隐藏地堡”条件下开放，此时对局时长40分钟。

tips.en: If you do get one, keep it only if you want to test the door yourself; the bunker's XP terminals work without it.
tips.zh: 如果捡到，除非想亲自试门，否则直接卖；地堡的经验终端不需要它。

tips.en: Antennas alert the whole lobby and bring ARC (Bastions and a Bombardier guard the entrances), so expect company.
tips.zh: 激活天线会惊动全场并引来ARC，入口还有堡垒和投弹手守着，做好遇敌准备。

verdict.en: A decent one-off gamble for a blue weapon and ammo, not worth a risky trip; the car is hard to find and the key sells for 100.
verdict.zh: 一次性的小赌注，能换一把蓝色武器和弹药，但车不好找，不值得冒险专程跑。

use.en: The key opens the rear door of an armored patrol car. Guides put those cars in the underground highway of the Blue Gate (reached by stairs and a zipline from the Headhouse), with several possible spawn spots and ARC around. Reported loot is mid-tier: usually one blue rifle or SMG plus ammo, sometimes attachments or materials. The key is consumed.
use.zh: 钥匙用来打开装甲巡逻车的后门。攻略把这些车放在蓝门的地下高速隧道（从候车室走楼梯、坐滑索下去），刷新点不固定，周围有ARC。战利品中等：通常一把蓝色步枪或冲锋枪加弹药，偶尔有配件或材料。钥匙用完即消耗。

obtain.en: The quest A Prime Specimen rewards one. Otherwise it is a random find; guides name the Ruby Residence and Research & Administration areas on the Dam, plus Checkpoint guardhouses. The wiki also lists Riven Tides for the car.
obtain.zh: 任务“完美样本”奖励一把。其余靠随机搜到，攻略提到大坝的红宝石宅邸、研究与行政区和检查站岗亭。社区维基也把裂潮镇列为巡逻车所在地。

tips.en: Put it in your Safe Pocket right away; dying with it loses the whole trip.
tips.zh: 拿到后马上放进安全口袋，带着它死掉整趟就白跑。

tips.en: The car's position changes each raid and is not marked, so only go if you are already heading underground.
tips.zh: 车的位置每局不同且地图不标，顺路下地下时再去。

verdict.en: Use it when you have it: the Observatory key room is the only reported source of the Cerulean stencil, and the key sells for just 100.
verdict.zh: 拿到就用：天文台钥匙房是目前唯一有报告的“苍蓝”贴花来源，钥匙本身只卖100钱币。

use.en: It opens a door in the main building of Cielo Sereno Observatory. Launch-week route: climb the stairs to the north entrance, make a U-turn inside and take the tunnel on your right, turn left in the next room, then take the first right; the door is straight ahead. Watch the hole in the floor on the way, which can drop you out of the building. Early reports mention blueprints, gear and keys inside, and a stencil guide places Cerulean here.
use.zh: 它打开晴空天文台主楼里的一扇门。首周路线：走台阶到北侧入口，进门后掉头走右手边的通道，到下一个房间左转，再走第一个右转，门就在正前方。途中地板有个洞，掉下去会直接摔出楼外。早期报告提到房内有蓝图、装备和钥匙，一份贴花攻略称“苍蓝”贴花也出在这里。

obtain.en: The quest Belly of the Beast rewards one. A week after launch no guide documents a random drop spot.
obtain.zh: 任务“兽腹深处”奖励一把。上线一周后仍没有攻略记录随机掉落点。

tips.en: Don't go during the ARC Frigate condition: every locked door is already open then and loot value is lower, so the key would be wasted.
tips.zh: ARC护卫者条件下别去：此时所有锁门已经开着，战利品价值也偏低，钥匙会浪费。

tips.en: The Observatory has a Bastion near its power console; avoid it unless you want a fight.
tips.zh: 天文台电源控制台附近有堡垒，不想硬打就绕开。

verdict.en: A cheap key worth using on an Old Town pass: the Hotel Pensione room holds grenade cases and cupboards, not a jackpot.
verdict.zh: 便宜钥匙，路过老城区就用：那栋旅馆里的这间房有手雷箱和橱柜，谈不上大奖。

use.en: It opens an apartment door in Hotel Pensione in Old Town. Enter through the gap in the southwest wall where the door was blown off; the locked door is on your left. A launch-week guide found loose items, grenade cases, cabinets and cupboards, and suggests looting downstairs first, then going upstairs and leaving through the window.
use.zh: 它打开老城区一栋旅馆楼里的一间公寓门。从西南墙被炸开的缺口进去，锁着的门就在左手边。首周攻略在里面找到散落物品、手雷箱、柜子和橱柜，建议先搜楼下，再上楼从窗户离开。

obtain.en: No guide documents a drop spot a week after launch; it is a random container find.
obtain.zh: 上线一周后仍无攻略记录掉落点，只能在容器里随缘获得。

tips.en: Skip it during the ARC Frigate condition, when all locked doors are open anyway.
tips.zh: ARC护卫者条件下别用，此时所有锁门本来就是开的。

tips.en: Sale value is 100; if you won't be in Old Town soon, selling is fine.
tips.zh: 售价100钱币；短期不去老城区的话卖掉也无妨。

verdict.en: Use it: one small Railyard room packed with crates, cases and wall cabinets, and the door is easy to reach.
verdict.zh: 值得用：铁路站场里一间小房，塞满箱子和壁柜，门也好找。

use.en: It opens a door in the Controlled Receiving Facility at the Railyard. Enter by the east side door (press the button to open it), climb to the second level and turn right; the door is beside the stairs behind a pillar. A launch-week guide reports crates, cases and wall cabinets with ammo, barricade kits and attachments. The Railyard is Pendola Pass's largest Industrial and Mechanical area, so loot the lockers on the way out.
use.zh: 它打开铁路站场受控收货设施里的一扇门。从东侧门进入（按按钮开门），上到二层右转，门在楼梯旁的柱子后面。首周攻略称房内有箱子和壁柜，出过弹药、路障工具和配件。铁路站场是彭多拉山口最大的工业和机械物资区，出来时顺手搜储物柜。

obtain.en: No guide documents a drop spot yet; treat it as a random find.
obtain.zh: 目前没有攻略记录掉落点，算随机掉落。

tips.en: Not worth carrying into an ARC Frigate raid, where the door is already open.
tips.zh: ARC护卫者条件下不用带，门本来就是开的。

tips.en: Rare rarity but the same 100 coin sale price as common keys, so using it beats selling it.
tips.zh: 稀有度是稀有，但售价和普通钥匙一样只有100钱币，用掉比卖掉划算。

verdict.en: The easiest Pendola Pass key door to find, but nobody has listed its loot yet, so use it in passing.
verdict.zh: 彭多拉山口最好找的钥匙门，但还没人列出房内物资，顺路再用。

use.en: It opens a door in Almatera Station on the west side of the map. Enter from the west and look for the red light above the locked door, just left of the main entrance. The room's contents are still unreported. The station around it rolls Commercial loot (21 container spots in an ordinary round), so expect sellable valuables nearby.
use.zh: 它打开地图西侧阿尔玛特拉站里的一扇门。从西侧进站，找门上方亮红灯的那扇，就在正门左手边。房内物资尚无报告。车站本身是商业物资区（普通对局约21个容器点），附近多是能卖钱的贵重品。

obtain.en: No drop spot is documented; it is a random find.
obtain.zh: 没有记录在案的掉落点，随机获得。

tips.en: The sale price is only 100, so the key is only worth keeping if you actually plan to visit the station.
tips.zh: 售价只有100，只有真打算去车站时才值得留着。

verdict.en: Only matters during the Blue Gate Locked Gate event; otherwise it's a 100-coin throwaway.
verdict.zh: 只在蓝门的“上锁的大门”事件中有用，平时就是100钱币的杂物。

use.en: One of four codes needed to open the main gate in the Checkpoint area. Take all four to the Gate Control Room and enter them at its terminals. The gate then opens, and guides say it leads to plenty of valuable loot. During the event Raider Hatches and underground tunnels are blocked and the raid is 40 minutes, so expect contested fights.
use.zh: 打开检查站主门所需的四个安全码之一。把四个码带到蓝门控制室的终端输入，大门就会开启，攻略称里面有不少高价值战利品。事件期间奇袭者暗门和地下隧道不可用，每局40分钟，对抗激烈。

obtain.en: Search containers in Pilgrim's Peak on the Blue Gate; two Rocketeers guard it. The codes appear only while the Locked Gate event is active, and you can collect them across raids by extracting.
obtain.zh: 在蓝门的朝圣峰搜容器，那里有两名火箭手守着。安全码只在事件期间出现，可以分几局带出来凑齐。

tips.en: If you extract or use a Safe Pocket you needn't find all four codes in one raid.
tips.zh: 成功撤离或放进安全口袋的话，不必在一局里集齐四个码。

verdict.en: An insurance exit: craft it, keep one in your Safe Pocket, and spend it only on loot worth more than the key.
verdict.zh: 保险用的撤离钥匙：自己制作，安全口袋里留一把，只在战利品比钥匙值钱时才用。

use.en: It opens any Raider Hatch, a quiet exit with no alarm that avoids crowded extraction points. It is single-use. Guides advise not burning one on a cheap run, and saving it for a bad exfil situation or a quest that needs a hatch. Hatches are disabled during Night Raids and the Locked Gate event.
use.zh: 它能打开任何奇袭者暗门，是不拉警报、避开拥挤撤离点的安静出口，一次性消耗。攻略建议别在低价值的局里浪费，留给撤离点被堵的情况或需要暗门的任务。夜间奇袭和上锁的大门事件中暗门不可用。

obtain.en: Craft it in-raid or at Utility Station level 2 from Advanced Electrical Components and Sensors, far cheaper than Shani's 9,000-coin offer (limit 2). Six quests (Hatch Repairs, Cold Storage, The Trifecta, Mixed Signals, Our Presence up There, Paving the Way) also reward one.
obtain.zh: 在局内或2级工具工作台用高级电子元件和传感器制作，比萨尼9000钱币（限购2把）划算得多。暗门维修、冷冻储藏、三连胜、混合信号、我们在上面的据点、开辟道路六个任务也会奖励一把。

tips.en: Extra crafted keys are worth selling: the materials cost far less than the 2,000-coin sale price.
tips.zh: 多做的钥匙可以卖，材料成本远低于2000钱币的售价。

tips.en: Plan the exit early instead of waiting for the last exfil.
tips.zh: 撤离路线要提前规划，别等到最后一个撤离点。

verdict.en: One of four Locked Gate event codes on the Blue Gate; useful only during that event, otherwise worth 100 coins.
verdict.zh: 蓝门“上锁的大门”事件四个安全码之一，只在事件期间有用，否则值100钱币。

use.en: Enter it with the other three at the terminals in the Gate Control Room, which sits in the Warehouse Complex between the central and northern Blue Gate. When all four are in, the main gate in the Checkpoint area opens to valuable loot.
use.zh: 和其他三个码一起输入蓝门控制室的终端，控制室在蓝门中北部的仓储综合区。四个码齐了，检查站的主门就会开启，里面有高价值战利品。

obtain.en: Loot containers in Raider's Refuge on the Blue Gate, only while the Locked Gate event is active. Guides say the four codes always spawn in the same four areas, but descriptions of this one vary.
obtain.zh: 事件期间在蓝门的奇袭者避难所搜容器。攻略称四个码固定刷在四个区域，但各攻略对这里的描述不一。

tips.en: Each code can be carried out over several raids if you extract, so collect and bank them.
tips.zh: 成功撤离就能分多局把码带出来，先存着。

verdict.en: A Locked Gate event code: worth picking up if you are doing that event, otherwise a 100-coin sale.
verdict.zh: “上锁的大门”事件用码：做事件时顺手拿，否则卖100钱币。

use.en: It is one of the four codes entered at the Gate Control Room terminals on the Blue Gate. Entering all four opens the central gate at the Checkpoint. The event removes the tunnels and Raider Hatches, and the raid runs 40 minutes.
use.zh: 在蓝门控制室终端输入的四个码之一，四个码输入完成后检查站的中央大门开启。该事件会移除地下隧道和奇袭者暗门，每局40分钟。

obtain.en: Search containers in Reinforced Reception on the Blue Gate during the event. Exact container spots are not documented; expect to sweep the whole area.
obtain.zh: 事件期间在蓝门的加固前台搜容器。没有资料写明具体容器，需要花时间把整个区域搜一遍。

tips.en: The event isn't always on the map rotation, so don't hold the code waiting for it indefinitely.
tips.zh: 事件并非一直在地图轮换里，别无限期囤着等。

verdict.en: A high-risk, high-reward room: the key is worth using if you can survive the Port Authority Building.
verdict.zh: 高风险高回报：能在港务局大楼活下来的话，这张卡值得用。

use.en: It opens the Classified Records room on the upper floor of the Port Authority Building in the north of Riven Tides. Guides give different routes: the main stairs with a right turn on the second floor, or the east-side ladder to the top floor. Two doors lead into the same room. Reported loot is breachable containers, drawers and gun cases. Expect turrets, cameras and Shredders.
use.zh: 它打开裂潮镇北部港务局大楼上层的机密档案室。攻略给的路线不一：走主楼梯到二楼右转，或爬东侧梯子直上顶层。两扇门通向同一个房间。报告的物资有可破拆容器、抽屉和枪箱。门外有炮塔、摄像头和粉碎者。

obtain.en: Random drop on Riven Tides. One writer found theirs in a container in a second-floor room of Hotel Panorama Azzurro, but calls it luck.
obtain.zh: 裂潮镇随机掉落。有作者在蔚蓝全景酒店二楼一个房间的容器里拿到，但他自己也说是运气。

tips.en: Secure Storage shares this corridor and its turret: kill the turret, loot this room, then open Secure Storage if you carry that card too.
tips.zh: 安全储藏室和这里共用走廊和炮塔：先打掉炮塔，搜完这间，带着那张卡就接着开安全储藏室。

tips.en: Others may have already cleared the room before you arrive.
tips.zh: 你到之前，别人可能已经搜空了。

verdict.en: A decent room in a crane cabin above the Stacking Yard: a weapon case and a security locker sit by the door, but the climb leaves you exposed.
verdict.zh: 堆料场起重机驾驶室里的一间不错的房：门边有武器箱和安保储物柜，但爬上去时很暴露。

use.en: The door is in the operator cabin of the middle crane in the Stacking Yard. Climb the ladder to the control room (the door is on the left) or zipline in from the south end. One guide lists a weapon case, attachments, grenade tubes, file cabinets and sometimes a rare material; TroubleChute's map marks a weapon case and a security locker beside the door. Watch for Shredders on the catwalks.
use.zh: 门在堆料场中间那台起重机的驾驶室里。爬梯子上到控制室（门在左边），或从南端坐滑索进去。一份攻略列出武器箱、配件、手雷筒、文件柜，偶尔有稀有材料；社区互动地图在门边标了武器箱和安保储物柜。留意走道上的粉碎者。

obtain.en: Random container or enemy drop on Riven Tides; MetaForge says it occasionally turns up on Buried City too.
obtain.zh: 裂潮镇的容器或敌人随机掉落；有物品数据库称偶尔也会在掩埋废城出现。

tips.en: The cabin has one way in and out, so a camper can trap you. Clear the catwalks first and mine the entrance while you loot.
tips.zh: 驾驶室只有一个出入口，容易被堵。先清走道，搜刮时在入口放雷。

verdict.en: A cheap suite key at the hotel's west end; nobody has listed the loot, so open it only when you are already in the hotel.
verdict.zh: 酒店西端的廉价套房钥匙；没人列过房内物资，人在酒店时再开。

use.en: Suite 102 is at the west end of Hotel Panorama Azzurro, on the same floor as suites 107 and 113, per TroubleChute's map. The map marks two ways in close by: a balcony you can hop onto and a window you can climb through from the ground. No source lists what the room holds.
use.zh: 据一张社区互动地图，102号套房在蔚蓝全景酒店西端，与107、113同层。附近标了两个入口：一处可跳上的阳台，一扇能从地面爬进的窗户。目前没有资料列出房内物资。

obtain.en: Random container or player drop on Riven Tides; no fixed spawn.
obtain.zh: 裂潮镇容器或玩家身上随机掉落，没有固定刷新点。

tips.en: Suite 404 is also at the west end, on the top floor, so the two cards pair well in one trip.
tips.zh: 404号房也在西端顶层，两张卡可以一趟用掉。

verdict.en: Use it: room 107 has decent loot plus a safe that can hand you a Room 208 keycard.
verdict.zh: 值得用：107号房有不错的战利品，保险箱还能给你一张208号房卡。

use.en: The hotel is on the west side of Riven Tides. Room 107 is on the first floor, central corridor (take the lobby zipline or stairs; look for the red number over the door). It has suitcases, drawers and cabinets; high-tier weapons like Il Toro shotguns and Osprey rifles were seen. Check under the bed: the first visit's safe holds the No. 208 card, later visits usually random items.
use.zh: 酒店在裂潮镇西侧。107号房在二楼（即大堂上一层）的中央走廊，坐大堂滑索或走楼梯，门上方有红色房号。房里有行李箱、抽屉和柜子，见过高阶“公牛”霰弹枪和“鱼鹰”狙击枪。床下有保险箱：首次通常给208号房卡，之后多是随机物品。

obtain.en: The quest Battening Down rewards a card. It can also drop from residential looting on Riven Tides.
obtain.zh: 任务“加固防御”奖励一张，也可能在裂潮镇住宅区搜到。

tips.en: After room 107, go up the stairs to room 208 for a chained run.
tips.zh: 搜完107后上楼去208，可以连着做。

tips.en: Hallways are tight, so bring a close-range weapon.
tips.zh: 走廊狭窄，带近战距离武器。

verdict.en: A low-stakes suite key: fine if you already hold it, not worth a trip.
verdict.zh: 低风险的套房钥匙：手上有就用，不值得专程去。

use.en: Suite 113 is at the east end of Hotel Panorama Azzurro, on the same floor as 102 and 107, per TroubleChute's map, so it is a short detour from the east wing. No guide lists its loot and the community wiki page is a stub. The hotel is Riven Tides' main Residential and Commercial area (about 40 container spots in an ordinary round), so sweep the corridors either way.
use.zh: 据一张社区互动地图，113号套房在蔚蓝全景酒店东端，与102、107同层，从东翼绕过去很近。没有攻略列出房内物资，社区维基页面也只是空壳。酒店是裂潮镇主要的住宅和商业物资区（普通对局约40个容器点），走廊照样值得搜。

obtain.en: It turns up as a random drop from residential drawers, desks and lockers, or from downed players. Nobody has confirmed a fixed spawn.
obtain.zh: 随机掉落，常见于住宅抽屉、办公桌和储物柜，也可能从被击倒的玩家身上获得，目前没有确认的固定刷新点。

tips.en: Sells for 100 coins, so using it on a door you pass anyway beats selling it.
tips.zh: 卖价只有100钱币，顺路有门就用掉，比卖掉划算。

tips.en: One guide says keys are consumed on use and lost if you die, so don't carry it into a risky fight for a small room.
tips.zh: 有攻略称钥匙用一次就消耗，死亡会丢失，为一间小房间冒险带进高风险战斗不值得。

verdict.en: One of the better hotel suites: worth opening when you are already inside the hotel.
verdict.zh: 酒店里较值得开的套房之一，人已经在酒店里时再开。

use.en: Room 205 is on the second floor, central area of Hotel Panorama Azzurro; a stairs or zipline gets you up. One community guide says it holds weapons, medical items, chemicals and attachments, but that guide's details are unverified. Another guide wants a turret cleared first, and the hotel is a heavily contested PvP zone.
use.zh: 205号房在蔚蓝全景酒店二楼中部，可走楼梯或滑索上去。有社区攻略称房内有武器、医疗品、化学品和配件，但这些说法未经证实。另一篇攻略建议先清掉一座炮塔，而且酒店本身PvP激烈。

obtain.en: Random container drop; community guides name bedside tables, closets and bars, but none is confirmed.
obtain.zh: 随机容器掉落。社区攻略提到床头柜、清洁间和酒吧等地点，但都未经证实。

tips.en: Sell value is only 100 coins, so the room is the whole point: use it or leave it.
tips.zh: 卖价只有100钱币，价值全在房间里：要么用掉，要么留着。

verdict.en: Worth using: Room 208 is billed as the biggest suite on the floor.
verdict.zh: 值得用：208号房被称为该层最大的套房。

use.en: Room 208 is toward the east end of the hotel, one floor below suite 311, per TroubleChute's map. Guides call it the largest suite on the floor. One guide lists SMG and sniper blueprints, armor kits and high-grade components, but nobody has confirmed that list. Expect PvP in the hotel.
use.zh: 据一张社区互动地图，208号房在酒店偏东位置，比311号套房低一层。攻略称它是这层最大的套房。有攻略列出冲锋枪和狙击枪蓝图、护甲工具和高级零件，但无人证实。酒店里常有PvP。

obtain.en: Players report the 208 card in a small safe under the bed in Room 107, whose card the quest Battening Down rewards. Otherwise it is a random container or player drop.
obtain.zh: 玩家反馈208号房卡在107号房床底的小保险箱里，而107号房卡是任务“加固防御”的奖励。除此之外靠容器或玩家随机掉落。

tips.en: Do Battening Down for Apollo first: its 107 card is the most reliable way into the 107-to-208 chain.
tips.zh: 先做阿波罗的“加固防御”：它给的107号房卡是进入107→208链条最稳的办法。

verdict.en: Reasonable suite key, best paired with the 404 room on the same run.
verdict.zh: 不错的套房钥匙，最好和404号房同一趟一起开。

use.en: Several guides put Room 311 on the third floor of the hotel's east side, behind the east tower stairwell rather than the main entrance. Loot is not documented; one unreliable guide mentions a pull-style chest. One guide treats 311 and 404 as a pair with a rooftop extract.
use.zh: 多篇攻略把311号房放在酒店东侧三楼，要走东塔楼梯而非正门。房内战利品没有可靠记录，有篇可信度一般的攻略提到拉杆式箱子。有攻略把311和404当作一组，可从屋顶撤离。

obtain.en: Sources conflict on how it drops; looting the hotel is the usual route. Check what the hotel's containers give on your own runs.
obtain.zh: 来源对获取方式说法不一，通常靠搜刮酒店获得。实际以你自己搜刮酒店的结果为准。

tips.en: It is a common 100 coin key, so only carry it if you plan to open Room 311.
tips.zh: 只是100钱币的普通钥匙，打算开311号房时再带。

verdict.en: Top-floor suite key with almost no loot info: use it if the route is safe, don't plan around it.
verdict.zh: 顶层套房钥匙，几乎没有战利品信息：路线安全就用，别专门规划。

use.en: Room 404 is on the hotel's top floor at the west end. TroubleChute's map agrees with two other guides on that; a guide that chains it from 311 up an east stairwell is contradicted by the map, which puts 311 at the east end. The map notes you can take the stairs or a zipline instead of jumping along the ledge. No guide documents the loot.
use.zh: 404号房在酒店顶层西端，社区互动地图和另外两份攻略一致；有攻略说从311沿东侧楼梯接着开，但地图把311标在东端，与此矛盾。地图提示可以走楼梯或滑索，不必沿外檐跳。房内物资无人记录。

obtain.en: One source says it is found by looting; the community wiki lists the source as unknown. No confirmed spawn spot.
obtain.zh: 有来源称靠搜刮获得，社区维基标注来源未知，没有确认的刷新点。

tips.en: Suite 102 is at the same west end, three floors down, so carry both cards if you have them.
tips.zh: 102号套房同在西端、低三层，两张都有就一起带。

tips.en: Keys sell for 100 coins, so only keep it if you plan to open the door this raid.
tips.zh: 钥匙只卖100钱币，本局打算开门才带。

verdict.en: The most valuable Riven Tides card: an Epic key to the Port Authority's inner storage room.
verdict.zh: 裂潮镇最值钱的一张卡：港务局内部储藏室的史诗钥匙。

use.en: It opens the Secure Storage room in the Port Authority Building. Guides agree it shares the Classified Records corridor and turret; one describes it as a smaller locked room inside Classified Records, so bring both cards if you can. A Port Authority loot guide rates it the best loot in the building, at extreme risk.
use.zh: 它打开港务局大楼的安全储藏室。攻略一致认为它和机密档案室共用走廊和炮塔；有一份说它是机密档案室里面的一间小锁房，所以能带就两张卡一起带。一份港务局物资攻略把它评为全楼最好的物资，风险也最高。

obtain.en: A random drop, mostly from breachable containers; MetaForge's players report it most often on Buried City and during Night Raid.
obtain.zh: 随机掉落，多来自可破拆容器；有物品数据库的玩家反馈最常在掩埋废城和夜间奇袭中拿到。

tips.en: Bring it in a Safe Pocket; a keycard is lost if you die.
tips.zh: 放进安全口袋带进去，死了房卡就没了。

tips.en: Kill the turret first, loot Classified Records, then push Secure Storage straight after.
tips.zh: 先打掉炮塔，搜完机密档案室，紧接着开安全储藏室。

verdict.en: A quest key: only matters for the Last Entry quest, otherwise a 100-coin item.
verdict.zh: 任务钥匙：只对“最后条目”任务有用，否则只值100钱币。

use.en: It unlocks the Seed Vault entrance on Stella Montis for Shani's Last Entry quest. The clue terminal stands just outside the Seed Vault, in the tunnels under the Cultural Archives. From it, go straight and take the first room on the left: the key hangs on the rack of hazmat suits to your left and is easy to miss. Back at the terminal, open the vault, go through the shutters and straight on to the terminal with the Official Shutdown Documentation.
use.zh: 它为萨尼的任务“最后条目”打开星辰山种子库的入口。线索终端就在种子库外、文化档案馆下方的隧道里。从终端直走，进左手第一个房间：钥匙挂在左侧那排防护服架上，很容易漏看。回到终端旁开库门，穿过卷帘一直往前，就是放着官方关停文件的终端。

obtain.en: Only from the hazmat suit rack during Last Entry; all the quest steps must be done in one raid.
obtain.zh: 只能在“最后条目”任务中从防护服架上拿到；任务所有步骤须在同一局完成。

tips.en: Finish the quest before selling it; Shani rewards a Yellow Light Stick Blueprint.
tips.zh: 做完任务再卖；萨尼会奖励黄色荧光棒蓝图。

verdict.en: Worth using: one key gets you into all three top-floor rooms of Container Storage, but ARC and raiders crowd the building.
verdict.zh: 值得用：一把钥匙就能进集装箱仓库顶层全部三间房，但楼里ARC和玩家都多。

use.en: Container Storage is on the east side of the Spaceport near Vehicle Maintenance. Take the stairs on either side to the top floor, where three locked doors with red lights face east. Unlock one and you can open the other two from inside without more keys. Reported loot: ammo cases, industrial lockers, breachable containers and gears and components, with red lockers sometimes holding high-value items.
use.zh: 集装箱仓库在太空港东侧、载具维护区旁边。从任一侧楼梯上到顶层，三扇亮红灯的锁门朝东。开一扇进去后，另外两扇可以从里面打开，不再耗钥匙。报告的物资有弹药箱、工业储物柜、可破拆容器以及齿轮和零件，红色储物柜偶尔出高价值物品。

obtain.en: Random container drop. Guides suggest Residential areas such as Pale Apartments on Dam Battlegrounds and Grandioso Apartments on Buried City, but nothing is guaranteed.
obtain.zh: 容器随机掉落。攻略建议搜住宅区，比如大坝战场的苍白公寓和掩埋废城的奢华公寓，但都不保证。

tips.en: Fireballs patrol the area and other raiders head there often; clear the walkway before spending time on the doors.
tips.zh: 附近有火球巡逻，别的玩家也常来；先清干净走道，再花时间开门。

verdict.en: Opens the top of Control Tower A6, a room of drawers, computers and a Security Breach cabinet; Lost in Transmission even gives you one.
verdict.zh: 打开控制塔A6顶层：抽屉、电脑加一个安防突破柜；任务“迷失在传输中”还会送一把。

use.en: The doors are at the base of Control Tower A6, on the southwest side of the Spaceport building past the long lit hallway; the main one faces south and a second faces north. Opening one unlocks the others; inside, ride the zipline to the top. Reported loot: drawers with rare residential items, a med bag, a Security Breach cabinet, breachable computer cabinets, lootable computers and loose electronics.
use.zh: 门在控制塔A6底部，位于太空港主楼西南侧、过了那条长长的亮灯走廊；主门朝南，另一扇朝北。开一扇其余都会解锁；进去后坐滑索到顶层。报告的物资有装稀有住宅物品的抽屉、医疗包、安防突破柜、可破拆的电脑柜、可搜刮的电脑和散落电子件。

obtain.en: Shani hands you one when you accept Lost in Transmission; if lost, a replacement may appear in the Spaceport offices. It can also drop randomly.
obtain.zh: 接下“迷失在传输中”时萨尼会给你一把；丢失后可能在太空港办公室找到替代品。也可能随机掉落。

tips.en: You can leave the other ground doors locked behind you, which slows down anyone following you up.
tips.zh: 进去后其他底层门可以不开，让跟上来的人慢一步。

tips.en: The task must be done in one round, so don't wander off with the key.
tips.zh: 任务必须一局完成，拿着钥匙别到处乱跑。

verdict.en: Mostly a quest key: it opens one of eight Trench Tower doors.
verdict.zh: 主要是任务钥匙：能开壕沟塔八扇门中的一扇。

use.en: The wiki counts eight Trench Tower doors, two on the first floor and two on the second of each tower, one key per door; Destructoid says only the North Trench Tower takes it, via the stairs right in front of the tower. Turnabout sends you to the North tower for blackmail files. Loot behind the doors is not itemized. One guide notes a weapon case at the very top of the North tower that a zipline reaches without any key.
use.zh: 维基统计壕沟塔共八扇门，每座塔一楼两扇、二楼两扇，一把钥匙开一扇；另一份攻略则说只有北壕沟塔能用，从塔正前方的楼梯上去。任务“反将一军”要你去北塔找勒索文件。门后物资没有清单。另有攻略提到北塔最顶上有个武器箱，坐滑索就能上去，不用钥匙。

obtain.en: Celeste rewards one for Switching the Supply and gives one for Turnabout. It also drops at random; Destructoid's writer found one in the Research and Administration building on Dam Battlegrounds.
obtain.zh: 塞莱斯特在“更换水源”中奖励一把，“反将一军”也会给一把。也会随机掉落；有攻略作者在大坝战场的研究与行政区拿到过。

tips.en: One guide rates it low priority; use it for the quest, then sell spares for 100 coins.
tips.zh: 有攻略评为低优先级；任务用掉，多余的卖100钱币。

verdict.en: Low-priority key for a compact upstairs room in the Shipping Warehouse; nobody has listed what is inside.
verdict.zh: 优先级低：开货运仓库楼上一间小房，没人列过里面有什么。

use.en: It opens locked doors on the north side of the second floor of the Shipping Warehouse, in the northwest of the Spaceport. Run up the stairs and follow the corridor. Guides describe a compact loot room without itemizing it. The warehouse itself is Mechanical and Industrial loot (about 12 container spots in an ordinary round).
use.zh: 它打开太空港西北部货运仓库二楼北侧的锁门。跑上楼梯沿走廊走即可。攻略只说是一间紧凑的物资房，没有列清单。仓库本身是机械和工业物资区（普通对局约12个容器点）。

obtain.en: Random container drop. One guide claims Switching the Supply rewards it, but this wiki's quest data shows that quest giving a Trench Tower key instead.
obtain.zh: 容器随机掉落。有攻略说“更换水源”奖励这把钥匙，但本站任务数据显示该任务给的是壕沟塔钥匙。

tips.en: With no known payoff, selling for 100 coins is fine unless you scout the room yourself.
tips.zh: 没有已知回报，除非想自己探房，卖掉换100钱币也行。

verdict.en: Stella Montis's only Epic key, and the Archives storage room has weapon cases and breachable crates: take it to the door.
verdict.zh: 星辰山唯一的史诗级钥匙，档案馆储存室里有武器箱和可破拆箱：拿到就去开。

use.en: It opens the storage room in the Cultural Archives, directly east of the Lobby and one level above the Seed Vault; look for a roll-up door at the outer edge of the archive. Inside are breachable storage crates, drawers, weapon cases and raider backpacks. Shredders and Ticks often wait outside: kill the Shredder or slip in and shut the door behind you. The Seed Vault Airshaft extraction is close.
use.zh: 它打开文化档案馆储存室，位置在大厅正东、种子库上一层；找档案馆外缘的一扇卷帘门。里面有可破拆储物箱、抽屉、武器箱和奇袭者背包。门外常有粉碎者和跳蚤：要么打掉粉碎者，要么溜进去把门关上。种子库通风井撤离点就在附近。

obtain.en: Random drop, best odds in residential and high-value containers: Pale Apartments, Ruby Residence and Pattern House on Dam Battlegrounds; Grandioso Apartments on Buried City; suitcases and bins in Stella's Lobby and Business Center, and the metal drawers in the Lobby Metro room opposite the extraction call button.
obtain.zh: 随机掉落，住宅和高价值容器概率最高：大坝战场的苍白公寓、红宝石宅邸、壁画屋；掩埋废城的奢华公寓；星辰山大厅和商务中心的手提箱和垃圾桶，以及大厅地铁站撤离呼叫按钮对面房间的金属抽屉。

tips.en: Carry it in a Safe Pocket if you can; it is unrecoverable if you die.
tips.zh: 尽量放进安全口袋，死亡后就丢了。

verdict.en: An Uncommon key to an admin room in Assembly: better than random containers, not top-tier loot.
verdict.zh: 组装厂管理区的罕见级钥匙：比随便开容器强，但不是顶级物资。

use.en: From Assembly on the north side, head east along the Assembly Line to where the floor dips toward the tunnels, then go through the south door into the Central Corridor; the door is on your right, with a green line on the floor and an Assembly Admin sign. The Loading Bay is a good way in. One guide describes two floors of drawers, cabinets and monitors with a chance at Epic items and weapon blueprints.
use.zh: 从北侧的组装厂出发，沿组装厂装配线往东走到地面往隧道下沉处，从南门进中央走廊；门在右手边，地上有绿线，挂着组装厂管理区的牌子。从装卸区过去比较方便。一份攻略说里面有两层的抽屉、柜子和显示器，有机会出史诗级物品和武器蓝图。

obtain.en: Random container drop only; no quest gives it.
obtain.zh: 只有随机容器掉落，没有任务奖励。

tips.en: Without a Stella Montis run planned, selling it for 100 coins is reasonable.
tips.zh: 近期不跑星辰山的话，卖100钱币也合理。

verdict.en: The quest key for Someone Else's Shoes; the Medical Storage room behind it is reported to be well stocked.
verdict.zh: 任务“换核思考”的钥匙；门后的医疗仓库据说物资不少。

use.en: It opens the Storage door in Medical Research, on the lower floor near two pillars. From the southern end of Medical Research, go straight and the room is on your left; from Assembly, take the corridor to Medical Research and go down any stairs. Guides call the loot good and expect medical supplies and crafting materials, without a confirmed list.
use.zh: 它打开医学研究部下层两根柱子旁的储藏室门。从医学研究部南端直走，房间在左手边；从组装厂出发，沿走廊到医学研究部后从任一楼梯下去。攻略评价物资不错，推测有医疗用品和制作材料，但没有确切清单。

obtain.en: Celeste gives one for Someone Else's Shoes. It also drops at random; a Destructoid writer found one in Ruby Residence on Dam Battlegrounds.
obtain.zh: 塞莱斯特在“换核思考”中给一把。也会随机掉落；有攻略作者在大坝战场的红宝石宅邸拿到过。

tips.en: Use the quest copy first; extras sell for only 100 coins.
tips.zh: 先用任务那把；多的只卖100钱币。

verdict.en: A Rare key to a sealed room in the Security Checkpoint; go late in the raid, because shotgun turrets guard the approach.
verdict.zh: 安全检查站里一间封闭房的稀有钥匙；晚点再去，路上有霰弹炮塔守着。

use.en: The checkpoint is on the upper floor near the Security Bridge. From the Lobby, pass the main security gates, turn right into the small room behind reception and follow the back corridor to its end; turn left, then right, and the checkpoint is the first door on your right. The doors on the way are breach doors; the key is only for the inner door. The wiki lists a Box Locker inside; no guide itemizes more.
use.zh: 检查站在上层、安保区过道桥附近。从大厅穿过主安检闸门，右转进前台后面的小房间，沿后走廊走到底；左转再右转，右手第一扇门就是检查站。路上的门都是可破拆门，钥匙只用于里面那扇。维基列出房内有一个箱式储物柜，没有攻略列出更多。

obtain.en: Random container drop only; no quest gives it.
obtain.zh: 只有随机容器掉落，没有任务奖励。

tips.en: Automated shotgun turrets make a straight push costly; come back when the area has thinned out.
tips.zh: 自动霰弹炮塔让正面强推代价很高，等人少了再来。
